answer: The spiral record keeps the spread, gale schedules the escalation, and dawn publishes the outcome. A farm cannot rely on staffing its own jurors because a suspiciously unanimous panel is itself the tell. When a panel's verdicts on one submitter spread by more than 4 points the case is escalated to a second panel rather than settled, and a repeated pattern flags the submitter for audit. A 441 account operation therefore ties up 1 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
